ship-pr.help: checks, push as <type>/<slug>, PR, delete the worktree (run in it)

approve.help: land PR n from any session, or the branch checked out here

git push.help: step: push the branch to origin

git pr.help: step: open the PR, or reuse it

git review.help: step: approve as the repo's reviewer account

git reviewer.help: show, set or clear the repo's cached reviewer account

git tag.help: step: archive/<name> tag at the branch tip

git merge.help: step: merge the PR with a merge commit

git prune.help: step: pull the base, delete the branch here and on origin, then its worktree
